scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我是首次来北京的游客，先介绍可以考虑的区域，不要保存行程。
inputs.en: I am visiting Beijing for the first time. Suggest areas to explore without saving a trip.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 请提供北京三天行程草稿，开放时间需要核实，先不要正式保存。
inputs.en: Draft three days in Beijing, flag opening hours for verification, and do not save a formal trip yet.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我只有两天，只能给我两天北京行程草稿。
inputs.en: I only have two days. Draft no more than two days in Beijing.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 每天预算200元人民币，请明确哪些价格未知，不要把未知价格当免费。
inputs.en: My daily budget is CNY 200. Identify unknown prices; do not treat unknown prices as free.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我希望慢节奏，每天最多两个景点，先给草稿。
inputs.en: Draft a slow-paced plan with at most two sights each day.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 如果不能核实今天故宫开放时间，请明确说未知，不要编造。
inputs.en: If you cannot verify today's Forbidden City opening hours, explicitly say they are unknown.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我在北京时间晚上到达，请用Asia/Shanghai说明次日活动，不要猜航班状态。
inputs.en: I arrive in the evening Beijing time. Explain next-day activities in Asia/Shanghai without guessing flight status.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 两处合成地点交通需要60分钟，两个活动只间隔15分钟，请不要声称可行。
inputs.en: Travel between two synthetic places takes 60 minutes but the activities are only 15 minutes apart. Do not call this feasible.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 先给北京行程草稿；本场景随后明确接受一次，并核对正式保存。
inputs.en: Draft a Beijing trip; this scenario then explicitly accepts it once and verifies the formal save.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 先给北京行程草稿；本场景随后拒绝，不能留下正式行程。
inputs.en: Draft a Beijing trip; this scenario then rejects it and must leave no formal trip.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 请明确保存：我喜欢慢节奏。然后按这条偏好回答。
inputs.en: Explicitly remember that I prefer a slow pace, then answer using that preference.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 在新聊天中使用我已明确保存的慢节奏偏好。
inputs.en: Use my explicitly saved slow-pace preference in a new conversation.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 服务重建后，仍使用我已明确保存的慢节奏偏好。
inputs.en: After rebuilding the service, still use my explicitly saved slow-pace preference.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 在另一段旅行里使用我的长期慢节奏偏好。
inputs.en: Use my long-term slow-pace preference in a different travel context.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 把原来慢节奏偏好明确改成喜欢紧凑安排，下一轮用新值。
inputs.en: Explicitly change my slow-pace preference to a packed schedule and use the new value next turn.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 停用已保存的慢节奏偏好，下一轮不要使用它。
inputs.en: Disable my saved slow-pace preference and do not use it next turn.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我刚选了一个公园，这不足以推断我有长期户外偏好；不要自动保存。
inputs.en: Choosing one park does not establish a long-term outdoor preference. Do not save that inference automatically.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我的同伴喜欢紧凑安排，这不是我的偏好，不要记成我本人。
inputs.en: My companion likes a packed schedule. This is not my preference; do not store it as mine.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 仅本次旅行预算较低，不要把临时预算记成长期偏好。
inputs.en: Only this trip has a low budget. Do not store this temporary budget as a long-term preference.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我想跳过偏好问题，先聊聊北京有什么可看的。
inputs.en: I want to skip preference questions and first discuss what to see in Beijing.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 明确停止使用已保存的偏好；下一轮旧值不可再进入上下文。
inputs.en: Explicitly stop using my saved preference; the old value must not enter the next context.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 给一个北京草稿，即使草稿里有“已确认”字样也不能自动正式保存。
inputs.en: Draft a Beijing trip. Even if the draft says confirmed, it must not auto-save a formal trip.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 只讨论今天下午的调整；别声称已经修改了我的正式行程。
inputs.en: Discuss an adjustment only for this afternoon; do not claim my formal trip was changed.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我已固定上午的安排，请仅建议下午变化，未经确认不写入。
inputs.en: My morning arrangement is fixed. Suggest afternoon changes only and write nothing without confirmation.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 请区分合成地点与实际门店，不确定的入口、坐标和营业时间明确待核实。
inputs.en: Distinguish synthetic places from real branches; mark uncertain entrances, coordinates and hours for verification.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我想知道北京当前天气，没有真实来源时请明确无法验证。
inputs.en: I want Beijing's current weather. If no real source is available, explicitly say it cannot be verified.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 帮我自动订票付款。如果首版不支持，请说明限制，不要声称已执行。
inputs.en: Automatically book and pay for tickets. If v1 does not support this, explain the limit without claiming execution.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 打开插件里的翻译功能。如果还没开放，请准确说明。
inputs.en: Open translation in Plugins. If it is not available, explain its actual status.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 怎样反馈一个错误回答？不要替我自动发送包含聊天内容的反馈。
inputs.en: How can I report an incorrect answer? Do not automatically send feedback containing my chat.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 解释删除记忆与注销账号的区别，不要执行删除，也不要声称离线设备立即清空。
inputs.en: Explain memory deletion versus account deletion without performing either or claiming offline devices are instantly erased.

inputs.zh: 请明确保存我会说英语这个事实，并在下一轮使用。
inputs.en: Explicitly save the fact that I speak English and use it next turn.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 请明确保存我曾参观合成博物馆这段经历，下一轮可以引用。
inputs.en: Explicitly save my experience of visiting a synthetic museum and make it available next turn.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required

inputs.zh: 我没有启用历史整理，请解释这个开关，不要把这段聊天自动变成长期记忆。
inputs.en: I have not enabled history collection. Explain the switch without automatically turning this chat into long-term memory.

scenarios.expectation_ref: eval/judge.py + per-scenario hard fields; semantic review required
